mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies near the Verona Public Library, and please be aware the ISS passes overhead tonight, though you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The City of Verona is reminding everyone that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, which also affects refuse and recycling pickup schedules.
We have a full slate of entertainment, including live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, with various trivia nights starting throughout the weekend.
In a report regarding service calls, on November 2, a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct at a residence in the 100 block of West End Circle.
The flavor of the day is Really Reese's, and since the restaurant is currently open until 10:30 PM, now is a great time to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
